story.title: Karnataka Plans AI and Deeptech Innovation Centres in Tier-II and Tier-III Cities Beyond Bengaluru
story.summary: Karnataka's State Planning and Policy Commission has proposed a roadmap to decentralise the state's technology ecosystem by establishing Karnataka Innovation Orchestration Centers in tier-II and tier-III cities, moving beyond Bengaluru's dominant tech corridor. The plan targets deeptech incubation, applied AI research, and R&D activity in smaller urban centres as part of a strategy to make Karnataka a global model for technology-driven inclusive development. The initiative follows growing concern that Bengaluru's saturation is limiting India's broader tech expansion.
companies: Karnataka State Planning and Policy Commission
